definitions.power: |AF|^2 / N_el^2 (1 = ideal equal-amplitude array at its peak)
definitions.sign: exp(-i omega t); delay tau -> exp(+i omega tau)
definitions.hierarchy: W_(q,p) = G_q(f) U_p(f); element (q,p) at (q Msub + p) lambda0/2; exact factorized full far field, not point-source subarrays
definitions.trim: trim = constant phase per channel at f0 chosen for the REQUIRED step q tau_req(Msub); trim_p4 = Phase 4 H_trim as is
definitions.window: |sin - sin(theta0)| <= 1/(2 f_max Msub d_e); 40001-point sin grid, parabolic refinement (production grid finer than the 20001 lobe grid of Revision 6, same method)
definitions.strongest: strongest local maximum other than the design lobe over -90..90 deg, dB re design peak; ambiguity = strongest > -10 dB
